settings.label: Label zoom
settings.description: How far you zoom in before the zoom label mode and the close-up cards appear (percent; lower is sooner).

settings.label: Center force
settings.description: How strongly the graph is pulled toward its center.

settings.label: Repel force
settings.description: How strongly notes push each other apart.

settings.label: Link distance
settings.description: How far linked notes sit from each other (higher spreads links out).

settings.label: Group pull
settings.description: How strongly notes of the same group (Group by) are pulled together.

settings.label: Animate
settings.description: Animate the layout and camera moves. Always off when your system asks for reduced motion.

settings.label: Card property
settings.description: Property names, comma separated, whose first value a note's close-up card shows under its title (type, status or an enum property). The first one a note has set wins.
